services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: When you need a boat repair, choose SeaBrook Marine. We are New Orleans’s most state-of-the-art yacht repair and storage facility. Our full service, boat-repair facility is conveniently located near the Intracoastal Waterway and Lake Pontchartrain. We offer a wide range of specialty services like painting and carpentry for your boat. Dry-stack storage, as well as wet slip docking (30 and 50 Amps) are also available for smaller boats and deep draft vessels. We offer competitive daily, weekly, and monthly transit rates as well, so you know you’ll be receiving quality value! services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Renting a boat has never been easier and more affordable. Seabrook Harbor is a locally owned and operated full service marine and harbor in New Orleans and now offers boat rentals. We know that owning a boat is expensive, that is why Seabrook Harbor offers the excitement of boating with family and friends without the hastle. Enjoy a relaxing day on the lake or go fishing in one of many hot spots! Our vessels come equipped with the necessary USCG safety gear and we have recreational gear for additional fun! blurb: SeaBrook Harbor & Marine offers dry-stack boat storage protecting vessels from water and weather, boat rentals on Lake Pontchartrain, and a full-service marine repair facility. Guests can rent pontoon boats equipped with safety and recreational gear. The facility includes wet slip docking, fueling, a ship store, and a large repair yard with specialized services including painting, carpentry, and mechanical repairs.
